name: web-minimal-month-calendar-with-black-selected-day-and-event-list
title: Event calendar demo: September grid with a black selected day, faded neighbours and a list of events with add field
whatItIs: A white page with a bold title, a month header with chevrons, weekday letters, a grid of dates where the selected 25 is a black rounded square with a dot and out-of-month days are pale, then 'Events on September 25th, 2025' with two bordered rows (Kickoff Meeting, Design Review) each with a red trash icon, and a new event input with a black Add Event button.
whatItMeans: Clean and tidy; black selection and pale neighbours make the date obvious.
techniques: Mark the selected day as a black square.
List events below in bordered rows.
Add an inline input and black button.

vocabulary.definition: A date from an adjacent month shown faded.
A bordered list item with a delete icon.
An input paired with a primary button.
